tools.name: command_run
tools.description: Run a bounded diagnostic command inside the declared target runtime.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Read the live readiness and health state of the declared service.

tools.name: business_probe
tools.description: Check the declared public business operation and response status.

tools.name: metrics_read
tools.description: Read bounded Prometheus metrics or query results for the declared target.

metric.description: A metric expression selected from live metrics evidence.

tools.name: service_control
tools.description: Apply one bounded restore operation to the declared live service.

action.description: A bounded lifecycle or restore operation.

constraints: Do not read case root, evaluator files, hidden labels, scenario files, host credentials, or Docker sockets.
Tool calls and outputs are recorded in the writable trace directory.
